title: Structured JSON Logging with structlog — Companion Code
title_es: Logging estructurado JSON con structlog — Codigo complementario
description: Runnable structlog setup: JSON processor chain, contextvars binding, sensitive-data redaction and timing processors, plus a FastAPI-style middleware. Smoke test prints JSON to stdout.
description_es: Setup ejecutable de structlog: cadena de processors JSON, vinculacion con contextvars, processors de redaccion de datos sensibles y de timing, mas un middleware estilo FastAPI. El smoke test imprime JSON a stdout.
